findings.issue: The new line fits Liam and the paddleboard story, but it is his fourth soaked-after-falling-in joke ([2] 'swallowed half the harbour', [4] 'pride's a little soggy', [11] socks, [16] 'dripping on this boardwalk'). It also sits close to his closer: both are about him still dripping, so the closer lands as a repeat rather than a payoff. It doesn't copy the closer's wording, and nothing breaks.
findings.suggested_fix: script[11]: 'loud works for me. nobody will hear roxy telling the whole room i fell in twice' (liam, HAPPY, clue null). This keeps the paddleboard thread through the rivalry instead of the wet joke, so the closer stays the one dripping punchline.

summary: The declutter landed as the audit intended. Both agreement echoes are gone. Brooke's lively wish is one line with no 'ok my turn', and it keeps 'summer ended early' for Cormorant. A Liam banter line now separates her two wishes, and 'also,' makes the healthy line read as an afterthought rather than the next item on a list. The chat no longer feels like a sign-up sheet. Fairness is intact and, if anything, more implied: lively now shows only through 'a packed room, people laughing over each other', with no 'loud'. Vegetarian is still carried by [5], [6] and [9], which cover the Salt Marsh sides trap and the Driftwood 'not fish either' trap. Healthy is [12] and dairy is [14]-[15]. The 'Mina speaks up' beat ([5] plus Brooke's reaction at [7]) is untouched. Every outcome that points back to the chat still has its line: 'summer ended early' at [10], 'night-market fryers' at [12], 'not fish either' at [9], 'a real main this time' at [5]. The outcomes' 'loud table' and 'the loud place' are the friends describing the venue, so they don't need the word in the chat. There is one optional suggestion: Liam's new line adds a fourth wet joke that crowds his closer.
